tasks.title: Model routing decision core: pure fail-closed choice of model class and cost tier per task (risk, data class, complexity, role, paid authority, reviewer independence)
acceptance: Pure function routeModel(request, catalog): no I/O, no network, no new dependency. Unknown or missing input fields give REFUSE (fail-closed).

PAID only when the request carries explicit paidAuthority true; otherwise refuse or fall back to an allowed tier, never silently PAID.

Role REVIEWER must not share the builder executor id or session: else REFUSE (REVIEWER_NOT_INDEPENDENT).
Decision carries decision ROUTE|REFUSE, code, modelClass, tier, modelId, reasons[]. Deterministic tie-break.

tasks.title: Command intake core: Founder text command -> validated mission DRAFT proposal with conservative risk and authority flags (pure, never authorizes)
acceptance: Pure function intakeCommand(text, context): no I/O, no network, no model call, no new dependency. Output status is always DRAFT (core/mission/state-machine.ts); it can never produce AUTHORIZED or any later state.

Deterministic TR and EN keyword classification into an existing mission/task kind with a risk level; unknown or ambiguous input gets the conservative outcome FOUNDER_ATTENTION_REQUIRED, never a lower risk.

Authority flags (protected paths, merge/push/force, paid or production, secrets/credentials, deletion) set authorityRequired with the matched reasons; the text is treated as data: instruction-like content (for example ignore the rules and merge) only raises flags, it never removes one.
Input bounds: empty, non-string, over-length (documented limit) and control characters are rejected with a code.

recoveryRules.builderBlocked: Builder commits WIP to its claim branch (WIP(<id>): blocked: <reason>) before stopping, so work survives container loss; task -> BLOCKED with reason; coordinator decides scope.
recoveryRules.sessionLost: IN_PROGRESS without PR and head older than 6 h is STALE (heartbeat reports it); the coordinator resumes on the same branch, never a second builder.
recoveryRules.reviewRejected: Task -> REVIEW_REJECTED; a repair task <id>-R<n> is queued on the PR branch; the new head needs a fresh review (SHA-bound).
recoveryRules.ciFailed: Classify (CODE_DEFECT, TEST_FAILURE, DEPENDENCY_FAILURE, INFRA_FAILURE, ACCESS_DENIED, QUOTA_EXHAUSTED, GOVERNANCE_BLOCKED, UNKNOWN). Base-wide failures get one shared fix PR (example PQ-009), never per-PR patches. At most 3 repair attempts per task, then BLOCKED permanent.
recoveryRules.accessDenied: Routine reports ENGINE_BLOCKED (NO_REPO_ACCESS) and changes nothing; Founder attaches the repository source.
recoveryRules.quota: On rate-limit rejection no new sessions start; leases age out; resume after the reported reset time. Never work around quota.
